claim_boundary: RSH-064 N-API lockfiles are feature-appropriate derived locks anchored to the pinned neon 0.10.0 and 0.10.1 crate archives; the legacy-runtime frozen locks are preserved separately.

The direct UniAlloc runs do not constitute a Type Isolation compiler arm.
RSH-054 and RSH-056 remain blocked by strict root-cause attribution, even though their adapters execute.
